checklist_items.reason: Evidence is restricted to the field branches explicitly listed above; no full component claims
checklist_items.12.1: Opened from the page Add control as the only dialog. The role is dialog, the accessible name is the drawer title, the component is ant-drawer-content, and the first step is the archive URL card. The community browser count is 0
checklist_items.12.3: Default focus is the drawer panel. Tab and Shift+Tab each cycle the drawer controls. The drawer is aria-modal, so one focus-trap sentinel stays inside the trap and focus does not reach the page
checklist_items.1.1: On first open the custom add drawer shows an empty image-archive URL textbox. Its name is image_archive_url, its type is text, it is not required, and it has no maximum length. Its placeholder is https://containerimages.example/runner.tar. Resolve is visible. Archive size, the references inside the archive, and the community repository browser are absent. Series name is an empty textbox, not required, with no maximum length, and its placeholder says to leave the name blank so the image repository groups it. Image reference is an empty required textbox with no maximum length and placeholder registry.example/team/image:v1. Engine version is an empty textbox, not required, and its placeholder gives the example 0.17.1. Framework version is an empty required textbox and its placeholder gives the example 12.8. The inference engine and framework selects are visible and have no selected value. Host architecture is a collapsed combobox and the only selected value is multi. The rolling-tag switch is visible, unchecked, and not required. There is no spinbutton and there are five textboxes. Reading the drawer sends no image mutation. The later import POST sends engine vllm, framework cuda, engine version 0.10.2, framework version 12.8, architecture multi, rolling tag false, an empty registry source list, and the image reference with surrounding spaces removed. The independent GET stores those same fields.
checklist_items.1.3: The custom add drawer content wrapper is 640 pixels wide. Image reference, inference engine, framework, and framework version are the required fields on the custom add drawer. With the other three filled, submitting an empty image reference shows the enter-an-image-reference sentence on the image reference field and sends no image import. Submitting a whitespace-only image reference shows the tag sentence on that field and sends no image import. Submitting an empty framework version and submitting a whitespace-only framework version each show the enter-a-framework-version sentence on the framework version field and send no image import. The engine and framework comboboxes are read-only, so a whitespace string cannot be entered. Clearing the engine shows the select-an-inference-engine sentence on the engine field and sends no image import. Clearing the framework shows the select-a-framework sentence on the framework field and sends no image import.
checklist_items.1.8: The page header shows the built-in wordmark image with no console-title span, since no title is configured - the header is checked through the brand that actually renders rather than a default title string the product does not have. Filling every optional field, series name register-full, engine version 9.9.9, architecture amd64, the rolling tag on, and registry source https://containerimages.example/register-full.tar, with the required image reference registry.example/team/register-full:v9.9.9, engine vllm, framework cuda, and framework version 12.8, submits one POST to /api/v1/images/import. The body carries that series name and those version fields, source custom, rolling tag true, and that one registry source. The 200 response is one series named register-full, purpose inference, enabled, with no nodes present. The independent GET keeps engine version 9.9.9, architecture amd64, rolling tag true, framework version 12.8, and that registry source. The list shows the series and opening it shows the saved reference. After reload the detail matches that GET. A separate create that leaves series name, engine version, the rolling tag, and registry sources untouched stores the backend defaults: derived name team/minimum, inferred engine version 1.2.3, architecture multi, rolling tag false, purpose inference, enabled true, and no registry sources. Both series are catalog metadata. They do not deploy, schedule, authorize, or mount, and there is no agent and no workload.
checklist_items.1.7: The inference engine field sits in one column with class ant-col-sm-12. Filling only the required image reference registry.example/team/minimum:v1.2.3, engine vllm, framework cuda, and framework version 12.8, and leaving series name, engine version, the rolling tag, and registry sources untouched, submits one POST to /api/v1/images/import. The body names no series, sends engine vllm, framework cuda, source custom, an empty engine version, framework version 12.8, architecture multi, that image reference, rolling tag false, and no registry sources. The 200 response is one series named team/minimum, purpose inference, enabled, with no nodes present. The list shows that series. Opening it shows the saved reference. After reload the detail matches the independent GET, including engine version 1.2.3 inferred from the reference, framework version 12.8, architecture multi, rolling tag false, and no registry sources. The series is catalog metadata. It does not deploy, schedule, authorize, or mount, and there is no agent and no workload.
checklist_items.1.14: After the custom import, reloading the images page and opening the series shows the saved image reference with the tag v1 inside one code element. That reloaded detail agrees with the independent series GET. The stored reference is the typed registry.example reference with surrounding spaces removed, and its tag is v1. The series keeps the typed name, engine vllm, framework cuda, source custom, engine version 0.10.2, framework version 12.8, architecture multi, rolling tag false, and an empty registry source list. Enabled is true and purpose is inference. Present nodes and total nodes are both 0. The series is catalog metadata. It does not deploy, schedule, authorize, or mount, and there is no agent and no workload.
checklist_items.1.15: The custom add drawer stacks its sections in one vertical space whose row gap is 20 pixels. Tab reaches Add Image. Enter in the empty image reference sends no image import and leaves that field empty. Enter in the filled reference registry.example/team/enter:v1 sends no image import, leaves the drawer open, and keeps that reference. Submitting an empty image reference shows the enter-an-image-reference sentence. At 1440×900 the image reference and Add Image are both inside the viewport and do not overlap.
checklist_items.1.9: While the custom image import is held the Add Image button stays loading and a second click sends no further import. The later 200 is the only stored series
checklist_items.1.10: The 502 keeps the import drawer and the typed reference, series name, and versions, shows upstream fixture is unreachable, and stores no series. The retry 200 matches the independent detail GET
checklist_items.12.6: covered: While the custom image import is held the Add Image button shows the loading state and a second click sends no further import; the 502 keeps the typed reference, series name, and versions, shows upstream fixture is unreachable, and stores no series; the later 200 matches the independent detail GET and the reloaded link
checklist_items.2.1: Every text control in the register drawer is read before any edit, through exercise_register_inventory: the archive address, series name, image reference, engine version and framework version each have their actual value asserted with to_have_value('') rather than inferred from a placeholder, each carries its accessible label, and each placeholder is asserted separately. Required state is asserted per field through aria-required: the image reference and framework version are required, the others are not. The drawer is also counted - five textboxes, no spinbutton - so a control added or removed fails the case, and the whole sweep asserts that reading sent no mutation.
